verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents vendor-specific acceleration, but only on mobile and Apple silicon. It runs on the Hexagon NPU on Snapdragon devices. Its proprietary MetalRT engine targets Metal 3.1 GPU features on Apple M3 and later, with a llama.cpp fallback on M1/M2. An agentic pipeline generates kernels validated against the target silicon. Missing for 10: any evidence of NVIDIA (CUDA) or AMD (ROCm) GPU kernel support, documentation of desktop/discrete GPU backends, and independent benchmarks across GPU vendors.
